definitions.score_basis: saved per-seed pooled out-of-fold scores and their saved five-seed means
definitions.spearman: correlation of row and group average-tie ranks within the same metric and screen subset
definitions.subset: whole-screen finite numeric mean yield >= 0.05, including zeros; no row filtering
definitions.selection: retrospective top-k screen selection by descending saved row R2 or grouped R2
definitions.selection_evaluation: equal-weight mean saved grouped R2 of the selected screens; group choice minus row choice
definitions.matching_seed_selection: selection and grouped-score evaluation use the same saved seed
definitions.tie_break: exact score ties in top-k selection are broken alphabetically by source_name
definitions.discordance: an unordered screen pair has opposite strict R2 ordering under row and group splits; tied pairs are not discordant
definitions.leave_one_screen_out: omit each retained screen in turn and recompute row/group R2 Spearman across the remaining ten screens
definitions.seed_ranges: minimum and maximum across five overlapping saved seed estimates; descriptive ranges, not confidence intervals
definitions.analysis_operations: rank, compare and average saved scores; no model fits, predictions or loss regeneration
